Changes for MozillaThunderbird:

 * changed: RNP command-line utilities are no longer included
 with Thunderbird (bmo#2068130)
 * changed: Thundermail built-in add-on updated to v2.0.16
 (bmo#2071989)
 * fixed: Ctrl+Shift+K could fail to open the Quick Filter UI
 (bmo#2062942)
 * fixed: Nested S/MIME signed parts could fail to render
 (bmo#2062971)
 * fixed: Thunderbird could hang when waiting for IMAP server
 greeting during account setup (bmo#2028760)
 * fixed: Gmail OAuth2 authentication could intermittently fail
 on Windows (bmo#2063816)
 * fixed: `AppUpdatePin` policy did not prevent Thunderbird from
 updating beyond pinned version (bmo#1910603)
 * fixed: 'What's New?' linked to Release channel notes instead
 of ESR release notes (bmo#2073813)
 * fixed: Detached attachment links were truncated when folder
 path contained `&` (bmo#2060451)
 * fixed: Save All, Detach All, and Delete All failed after
 deleting one attachment (bmo#2057025)
 * fixed: Blank 1970-dated messages could appear from incomplete
 message file copies (bmo#209501)
 * fixed: Forwarded messages could display incorrect encoding
 (bmo#2059963)
 * fixed: Manual Get Messages failed after startup until
 toggling offline mode (bmo#2057431)
 * fixed: Thunderbird could crash on shutdown while waiting for
 OAuth2 password entry (bmo#1524247)
